mapper.select: SELECT * FROM COLLECT_CPU b WHERE b.COLLECT_CODE = ( SELECT MAX(to_number(COLLECT_CODE)) AS code FROM COLLECT_CPU WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId} )

SELECT MAX(ID) AS ID, MAX(COLLECT_TIME) AS COLLECT_TIME, MAX(to_number(COLLECT_CODE)) AS COLLECT_CODE, ASSET_ID, MAX(CREATE_TIME) AS CREATE_TIME, ROUND(AVG(CPU_USED_RATE), 2) AS CPU_USED_RATE FROM COLLECT_CPU WHERE COLLECT_TIME BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY ASSET_ID
select * from COLLECT_CPU where ID = ( SELECT MAX(ID) from COLLECT_CPU )
